ICONOCLAST_FIEFDOM.dread_tyrants_aura.rule_name: Dread Tyrants (Aura) — Dreaded Masters / Iconoclast Fiefdom detachment rule
ICONOCLAST_FIEFDOM.dread_tyrants_aura.quoted_text: TITANIC CHAOS KNIGHTS units from your army have the following abilities: Dread Tyrants (Aura): While a friendly DAMNED unit is within 9" of this unit, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, re-roll a Hit roll of 1 and re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
ICONOCLAST_FIEFDOM.dread_tyrants_aura.trigger: Attacker is a Chaos Knights unit whose name starts with 'War Dog' (proxy for the DAMNED keyword, which BSData does not yet capture as a static unit keyword) AND the army's detachment carries dread_tyrants_aura=True AND at least one alive friendly TITANIC Chaos Knights unit is within 9" of the attacker.
ICONOCLAST_FIEFDOM.dread_tyrants_aura.effect: att_reroll_hit_ones and att_reroll_wound_ones are both set True for that attack in Unit.attack. APPROXIMATION: uses 'War Dog' name-prefix as proxy for the DAMNED keyword; strictly correct because DAMNED is only held by War Dog units in an Iconoclast Fiefdom army.

simulator.extra_melee_profiles.rule_name: Multi-melee-weapon Fight phase resolution and [Extra Attacks] core keyword
simulator.extra_melee_profiles.quoted_text: If a model has more than one melee weapon, it can split its attacks between different targets, but if it does, all of the attacks from each weapon must be made against the same target. [...] Extra Attacks: A weapon with the [EXTRA ATTACKS] ability is resolved in addition to the model's other melee attacks; the Attacks characteristic of an [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapon is added to the model's Attacks for its normal melee weapons. Each time a model is making its attacks, it must first make the attacks from its [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons separately from any others, and any other restrictions or permissions that apply to the model's attacks do not apply to attacks made with its [EXTRA ATTACKS] weapons.
simulator.extra_melee_profiles.trigger: datasheet carries MORE THAN ONE melee weapon profile simultaneously (Knight Abominant Electroscourge + Balemace; Knight Rampager Reaper chainsword + Warpstrike claw; Knight Despoiler Warpstrike claw + Reaper chainsword; War Dog Karnivore Slaughterclaw + Reaper chaintalon; Imperial Knight Gallant Thunderstrike gauntlet + Reaper chainsword), or one of those weapons has the [EXTRA ATTACKS] keyword (Balemace). UnitProfile.extra_melee_profiles is populated for these chassis via data/overrides.json; the BSData mapper currently captures only one melee profile per datasheet. Chassis whose two melee weapons are wargear REPLACEMENTS (Knight Desecrator, War Dog Stalker, Imperial Knight Paladin/Errant/Warden/Preceptor — each allows Reaper chainsword to be replaced with a Thunderstrike gauntlet or equivalent) carry only the single mapped profile and do NOT populate extra_melee_profiles.
simulator.extra_melee_profiles.effect: Unit.attack's melee branch, after resolving the primary melee_* profile, additionally resolves each entry in UnitProfile.extra_melee_profiles as a separate attack-resolution pass against the same engaged target. Each pass uses its own attacks / weapon_damage_per_shot / hit_probability / ap / strength / sustained_hits / lethal_hits / devastating_wounds / lance / precision / anti_keywords. Damage from all passes is summed and applied as one Fight-phase output. This is the ADDITIVE companion to the MUTEX `simulator.multi_profile_weapon_selection` picker that handles ranged alt-modes.

simulator.harbingers_of_dread.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread — Deathly Terror (always-on) and Doom (R1 Dread pick)
simulator.harbingers_of_dread.quoted_text: If your Army Faction is CHAOS KNIGHTS, each model from your army with this ability gains Dread abilities, depending which are active for your army. The Deathly Terror ability is active for your army from the start of the battle. In addition, at the start of the first, third and fifth battle rounds, you can either select one of the other Dread abilities or randomly select two Dread abilities to apply by rolling two D6 and applying the results rolled, from those numbered 1-6 below. N/A - Deathly Terror (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. 2 - Doom: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.
simulator.harbingers_of_dread.trigger: Attacker's army faction is Chaos Knights. Deathly Terror fires every Battle-shock test: any enemy unit within 9" of any alive Chaos Knights model worsens its Leadership by 1 for the test (always-on, no gate). Doom fires per attack: target is currently Battle-shocked (read via Unit.is_currently_battle_shocked(round_num)) AND attacker is Chaos Knights (no gate — Doom modelled as the default R1 pick; suppressed when SWEG_HARBINGERS=1 in favour of Despair as R1 pick).
simulator.harbingers_of_dread.effect: Deathly Terror: +1 to the Battle-shock test target (harbinger_penalty) in code/simulator.py _run_battleshock_phase. Doom: wound_mod_delta += 1 in code/units.py Unit.attack when target is Battle-shocked. The R1/R3/R5 'select one additional Dread' rotation is collapsed to a static pick (Doom) at battle start. Under SWEG_HARBINGERS the remaining Dreads (Despair, Darkness, Dismay, Delirium) are also enabled — see simulator.harbingers_of_dread_despair, simulator.harbingers_of_dread_darkness, simulator.harbingers_of_dread_dismay, simulator.harbingers_of_dread_delirium.

simulator.harbingers_of_dread_despair.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread — Despair (Dread ability 1, gated SWEG_HARBINGERS)
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_despair.quoted_text: 1 - Despair (Aura): While an enemy unit is within 9" of this model, worsen the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1. This is cumulative with the Deathly Terror ability (see above).
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_despair.trigger: Enemy unit is within 9" of any alive Chaos Knights model AND SWEG_HARBINGERS=1. Modelled as active from the start of Round 1 (the rule allows picking one additional Dread at the start of Round 1; Despair is the conventional competitive choice).
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_despair.effect: despair_penalty = 1 added to the Battle-shock test target in code/simulator.py _run_battleshock_phase, stacking with the always-on harbinger_penalty (Deathly Terror) to give a combined Ld -2 within 9" of a Chaos Knights model.

simulator.harbingers_of_dread_darkness.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread — Darkness (Dread ability 3, gated SWEG_HARBINGERS)
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_darkness.quoted_text: 3 - Darkness: Each time an attack is made against this model, if the attacking model's unit is Battle-shocked or more than 18" away, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_darkness.trigger: The TARGET of the attack is a Chaos Knights model AND (the attacker's unit is currently Battle-shocked OR the distance to the target is greater than 18") AND SWEG_HARBINGERS=1. Modelled as active for the whole game (the rule allows a Dread pick each odd round; Darkness is collapsed to a standing effect under the gate for simplicity).
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_darkness.effect: hit_mod_delta -= 1 in code/units.py Unit.attack when the target is Chaos Knights and the attacker is Battle-shocked or beyond 18". Subject to the standard ±1 Hit modifier cap.

simulator.harbingers_of_dread_dismay.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread — Dismay (Dread ability 4, gated SWEG_HARBINGERS)
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_dismay.quoted_text: 4 - Dismay (Aura): In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, for each enemy unit that is below its Starting Strength and within 9" of this model, that enemy unit must take a Battle-shock test.
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_dismay.trigger: During the Battle-shock phase, a multi-model enemy squad has lost at least one model (below Starting Strength but not necessarily below Half-Strength) AND at least one member of that squad is within 9" of an alive Chaos Knights model AND SWEG_HARBINGERS=1. Single-model units are never below Starting Strength per 10e core and are unaffected.
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_dismay.effect: In code/simulator.py _run_battleshock_phase, the eligibility gate for the per-squad test loop is expanded: multi-model squads that are below Starting Strength and within 9" of a harbinger_source are forced to test even if not yet below Half-Strength (the existing Half-Strength path is unchanged). A squad already below Half-Strength enters via the normal path; Dismay only adds the intermediate (below-starting, not-below-half) cohort.

simulator.harbingers_of_dread_delirium.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread — Delirium (Dread ability 5, gated SWEG_HARBINGERS)
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_delirium.quoted_text: 5 - Delirium (Aura): While an enemy unit that is Below Half-strength is within 9" of this model, each time that model fails a Battle-shock test, it suffers D3 mortal wounds.
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_delirium.trigger: Enemy squad has just FAILED a Battle-shock test AND the squad is Below Half-Strength AND the squad representative is within 9" of an alive Chaos Knights model AND SWEG_HARBINGERS=1. Modelled as active for the whole game (collapsed from R5 pick for simplicity).
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_delirium.effect: After marking the squad as Battle-shocked in code/simulator.py _run_battleshock_phase, if the squad is Below Half-Strength and _harbinger_in_range, D3 mortal wounds are applied to the squad representative (same convention as Shadow of Chaos MWs). The Below Half-Strength check for multi-model squads uses alive_count < start_count / 2.0; for single-model units it uses rep.current_health < rep.profile.health / 2.0.

simulator.harbingers_of_dread_doom.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread — Doom (Dread ability 2, gated SWEG_CK_DOOM, default OFF)
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_doom.quoted_text: 2 - Doom: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll.
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_doom.trigger: Attacker's army faction is Chaos Knights AND the target is currently Battle-shocked (read via Unit.is_currently_battle_shocked(round_num)) AND SWEG_CK_DOOM=1. Fires in both melee and ranged attack resolution. Independent of SWEG_HARBINGERS: when SWEG_HARBINGERS=1 (default), the existing Harbingers suite (Despair, Darkness, Dismay, Delirium) is active but Doom is suppressed to stay within the 3-pick Harbingers limit; SWEG_CK_DOOM=1 lifts that suppression and makes Doom additionally active. Direction: raises Chaos Knights win rate (under-poled faction: sim approximately 37-40 percent vs real approximately 45 percent).
simulator.harbingers_of_dread_doom.effect: wound_mod_delta += 1 in code/units.py Unit.attack when the Chaos Knights attacker fires at a Battle-shocked target. Subject to the standard plus-or-minus-one Wound modifier cap applied later in the same function. When SWEG_CK_DOOM is unset or set to '0' (default), the block is skipped entirely and the output is byte-identical to the base with SWEG_CK_DOOM absent.

strategy.ck_dread_cascade_target.rule_name: Harbingers of Dread / War Dog Executioner — Below-Half-strength target focus (artificial-intelligence target-selection bias)
strategy.ck_dread_cascade_target.quoted_text: Doom: Each time this model makes an attack, if the target of that attack is Battle-shocked, add 1 to the Wound roll. [War Dog Executioner] Each time this model makes a ranged attack that targets a unit that is Below Half-strength, add 1 to the Hit roll.
strategy.ck_dread_cascade_target.trigger: SWEG_CK_DREAD_FOCUS default-on (ADOPTED 2026-07-01; '0' is the byte-identical kill-switch); the attacker's army faction is Chaos Knights and the candidate target is Below Half-strength (defender.current_health < defender.profile.health / 2)
strategy.ck_dread_cascade_target.effect: ARTIFICIAL-INTELLIGENCE PILOTING HEURISTIC — not a separate 10e rule. The Chaos Knights Harbingers of Dread / War Dog Executioner mechanics reward finishing wounded enemies (Doom's +1-to-Wound vs Battle-shocked targets, cited separately under SWEG_CK_DOOM; the Executioner's +1-to-Hit and Battle-shock-cascade-on-kill vs Below-Half targets; Delirium's mortal wounds to Below-Half units failing Battle-shock). Below-Half-strength is the unified proxy for that class of targets. This heuristic makes the Chaos Knights shooting picker PREFER Below-Half enemy units: _ck_dread_cascade_target_bonus (code/strategy.py) returns a 2.0x score multiplier for a Below-Half defender when the attacker is Chaos Knights, which the shooting picker divides the target-score by, biasing the min(...) pick toward those targets. It concentrates fire on the CLASS of Below-Half enemies (not a single designated unit), so it does not over-concentrate the way a single-target bias does (contrast the rejected T'au single-Spotted-target guided bias). Chaos-Knights-scoped paired N=80 vs sc27a: gated 2.46 -> 2.43, Chaos Knights +0.57 toward real 44.7, no decisive collateral, no overshoot. Off path (SWEG_CK_DREAD_FOCUS=0) returns 1.0 -> byte-identical. Same artificial-intelligence-heuristic class as _astartes_oath_target_bonus.
